folds.title: Subagents
points: A **subagent** is a helper with its own context window.
It does a side job, like searching a big codebase.
It sends back only a short summary, so your main conversation stays tidy.

folds.title: Using subagents
points: Claude can delegate on its own when a task matches a subagent's description.
Or you can ask for one by name.
Built-in helpers handle read-only search and planning.

folds.title: Making subagents
points: Subagents are Markdown files, so you can ask Claude to write one.
You can limit what one may do, such as read-only tools.
Their work still counts toward your usage.

folds.title: A subagent at work

chat.you: Use a subagent to find every place this app sends an email.

chat.claude: The helper searched the whole codebase. Summary: emails go out from three files. Here they are.

folds.note: The long search stayed out of your main chat.

folds.title: Plugins
points: A **plugin** bundles extras to install in one go.
It can add skills, agents, hooks and MCP servers.
Plugins come from **marketplaces**, which are catalogues of plugins.

folds.title: Using plugins
points: Run `/plugin` to browse and manage them.
A plugin can run hooks and servers.
So read what it will install first, and be careful with sources you do not know.

folds.prompt: Subagent or plugin? Tap the basket.
